reference: Girl, apparently it left the dish yesterday, not today.
sk: Zlatko, vraj opustil misku včera, nie dnes.
cz: Holka, prý opustil mísu včera, ne dneska.

mistakes.text: {Girl|Sweetie}, apparently it leaves the {dish|bowl} yesterday, not today.
{Girl|Sweetie}, apparently it leaved the {dish|bowl} yesterday, not today.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Past Simple je „leave“ → „left“, nie s -ed.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Past Simple je „leave“ → „left“, ne s -ed.

mistakes.text: {Girl|Sweetie}, apparently it has left the {dish|bowl} yesterday, not today.
mistakes.feedback_sk: S „yesterday“ nepoužívaj Present Perfect, patrí tu Past Simple: „left“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: S „yesterday“ nepoužívej Present Perfect, patří sem Past Simple: „left“.

mistakes.text: {Girl|Sweetie}, apparently it left from the {dish|bowl} yesterday, not today.
{Girl|Sweetie}, apparently it left the {dish|bowl} yesterday, no today.

source_issues: SK addresses 'Zlatko' (sweetie), CZ and EN 'Holka/Girl'; affectionate vocatives accepted.
SK/CZ 'miska/mísa' = bowl; 'bowl' accepted besides 'dish'. Masculine 'opustil' allows 'he' for the animal.
